title: Aimbot Silent Aim Esp Player Fast Speed High Jump OP AUTOAIM
features:
## BLOXFRUIT AIMBOT

- Aim Skill Player You Select - Aimbot for manually selected player
- Auto Aim Skill Player Near - **Silent Aim**
- Distance Aim Skill - Adjustable range for auto aimbot (100-1000)
- Fast Attack - Enhanced attack speed

## Buff Features:

- Walk on Water - Allows walking on water surfaces
- Walk Speed - Toggle enhanced walking speed
- Jump Power - Toggle enhanced jump ppowe
- Inf Jump - Infinite jumping capability

Visual Features:

## ESP Player 
- Player ESP with team-based colors:
   · Red for Pirates
   · Blue for Marines
   · White for other teams
   · Shows player name and distance
